title: WaterColor 11 WaterColor Blvd W #201
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located in WaterColor's Park District- 2 Adult bikes- Furnished balconies overlooking park- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Located in the Park District! 11 WaterColor Blvd. W #201 is a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom WaterColor condo that sleeps 6. Guests can enjoy gorgeous views of Cerulean Park from 2 balconies and are within steps of the Beach Club, restaurants, beach access, and shopping.Guests will love the bright and cheery interiors of this spacious condo. Hardwood floors reflect light from multiple French doors that open to a long balcony. A primary bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with a jetted tub and separate shower. A guest bedroom has 2 twin beds and shares a bathroom with the living area. A dining table seats 6 and is conveniently located beside the kitchen, where stainless steel appliances and wrap-around countertops provide plenty of space to prepare meals. After a busy day at the Beach Club or jumping waves in the Gulf, guests will appreciate the comfortably spacious living area. Oversized armchairs and a queen sleeper sofa surround a 65” TV, and enjoy views of the balcony and park. French doors open to a long balcony with beautiful views of Cerulean Park, a gorgeous park with a water feature that runs the entire length. Listen to early morning birdsong while sipping coffee, or share a meal in the screened portion—all the beauty of WaterColor without pesky mosquitos!Relax and stay in the heart of one of 30A’s most famous beach communities.Guests can easily explore WaterColor on 2 included adult bikes. Enjoy nature trails along Western Lake, bike to Camp WaterColor for an afternoon waterslide ride, or explore Timpoochee Trail, 30A’s bike path. With its incredible location, 11 WaterColor Blvd. W #201 will book quickly.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Living Room: Queen SleeperWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves**Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
